cs.t: I bought a tempur-pedic earlier this year and I have to say it's the best sleep I've ever had.  I used to toss and turn during the night and I usually had back pain in the mornings, but not with the tempur-pedic.  I get uninterrupted sleep and no morning back pain. My previous mattresses were decent spring types and they were comfortable, but nothing compared to the tempur-pedic.
cs.th: Ask HN: which mattress for best sleep?
